text:
Rae (People Ops): quick brainstorm Recognition Snack Bar for our next culture week: small desk packages with a non-perishable snack, a tiny thank-you card, and a digital badge code. low-touch and easy to distribute. thoughts? :cookie:
Izzy (Events): love it. make snack non-perishable and allergy-friendly. maybe offer two options: nut-free snack or tea sachet. simple kraft sleeve with sticker branding works.
Tomas (Global Ops): flag: certain countries restrict food imports (AU/NZ) and some require specific labeling. we'll need a regional plan: US desk drops, EU direct-ship from EU printer, APAC consolidated to SG hub, and opt-out for restricted countries.
Priya (HR Ops): contractor policy: low-value gifts are usually fine but must be recorded. I'll check AU/CA contractor rules and draft opt-out + allergy fields for the RSVP. Also recommend a short manager note to avoid awkward surprises.
Ben (Procurement): ballpark: 500 kits basic (snack+card+sleeve) ~$2.30/unit US, EU print-and-ship slightly higher. Lead time ~10 business days. I'll get quotes from two vendors and confirm if vendors can suppress snacks per-address via CSV flag.
hr-bot: Reminder: fill the Gifts & Distribution sheet before placing an order: https://drive.company/gifts
Rae (People Ops): target audience ~440 incl contractors, ordering 475 to cover extras. timeline: decide contents by Jul 10, finalize art Jul 14, order Jul 18, ship Aug 1-5. Can we hit that?
Izzy (Events): yes, will mock two sleeve designs and post in #design-review tomorrow.
Tomas (Global Ops): I'll compile a list of countries requiring alternative items and propose hubs by Jul 8.
Priya (HR Ops): I'll complete contractor checks and opt-out wording by Jul 6.
Ben (Procurement): will share vendor quotes + PO template by Jul 9.
Rae (People Ops): action list: (1) Izzy designs (2) Ben quotes + PO (3) Priya compliance + opt-out (4) Tomas regional plan + CSV schema. I'll make a short RSVP form and volunteer signup for desk drops. Anyone else to loop in?
Priya (HR Ops): cc Legal for cross-border gift terms.
Izzy (Events): tagging @design for quick approval.
Rae (People Ops): perfect. fallback if food blocked: replace snack with a locally-sourced non-food item (tea sachet/postcard). thanks team :tada:
